Ending a temporary allowance increase counts as a reduction in usage available to subscribers, even if the underlying standard allowance is unchanged.
The subscription prices identify customer tiers; this is not a claim about company revenue or spending.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous company records show that available Plus Codex usage was reduced or shifted away from longer sessions alongside the $100 tier launch.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records show that Plus Codex allowances remained unchanged or increased through the launch, with no contemporaneous reduction in available session usage.
